en.title: WebGL2 2D host builds its programs together
en.body: With KHR_parallel_shader_compile, the shared WebGL2 host compiles and links all startup and restore programs first and then asks their completion every 8 ms, so startup no longer blocks the page while the driver compiles one program after another. Without the extension, startup is unchanged.

zh.title: WebGL2 2D 宿主并行构建着色器程序
zh.body: 上下文支持 KHR_parallel_shader_compile 时，共享 WebGL2 宿主在启动与恢复中先编译并链接全部程序，再每 8 ms 询问完成状态，不再在驱动逐个编译时阻塞页面。没有该扩展时启动流程不变。
